n, B = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0
diffs = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount:
        diffs.append(abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]))

diffs.sort()
totalSum = 0
count = 0
for d in diffs:
    totalSum += d
    if totalSum > B:
        break
    count += 1

print(count)
</translated_code>
